content: Listen to the reed how it complains, telling a tale of separations.
author: Rumi
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Genuine love is not a transaction where you keep score of who gave what; it is a state of being where you extend warmth and goodwill without needing to control the other person.

Rumi understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. The biggest barrier to deep connection is never external; it is our own fear of rejection. We build armor around our hearts to avoid pain, but that same armor ends up locking out the warmth and intimacy we crave.
reflectionPrompt: In what relationship or encounter can you practice seeing beyond outer masks into shared humanity?
